NHAI to upgrade toilets at toll plazas nationwide

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has initiated a nationwide campaign to upgrade toilet facilities at toll plazas. This upgrade includes implementing IoT-based monitoring systems to track usage and cleanliness. Maintenance will be linked to performance metrics, ensuring higher standards. The initiative aims to improve passenger amenities across the national highway network.
